notes: Renders role="group" and accepts aria-label or aria-labelledby to name the collection
Marks a disabled group with aria-disabled and disables every child that does not set its own disabled value
Moves focus between grouped controls with the arrow keys matching the orientation, wrapping at both ends, while leaving other keys to the focused control
Composes with a consumer onKeyDown handler instead of replacing it
Renders one shared focus ring that tracks the focused grouped surface

usage.summary: Compose related controls using Group.Button, Group.Input, and Group.Select. Use Group value/onChange with Group.Button value for controlled toggle groups.

rules.title: Compose grouped selects
rules.description: Group.Select uses Select.Trigger and Select.Content containing Select.List and Select.Item children.

rules.title: Use the standalone divider
rules.description: Place Divider inside Group; there is no Group.Divider part.

contract.element: div role="group" inside a sizing/focus wrapper
contract.nativeProps: Div attributes and events go to the inner group. className styles that group; w-full/flex-1 also propagate to the outer sizing wrapper.
contract.state: Group holds no selection state. Supply value and onChange; Group.Button value identifies each toggle. Group disabled applies unless a part explicitly overrides it.
contract.layout: Each direct child gets an item wrapper. orientation controls layout and arrow navigation; spacing="none" joins surfaces.
contract.composition: Use Group.Button/Input/Select/Expand. Use standalone Divider, not Group.Divider. Tooltip can wrap Group.Button as one group child. Nested groups own their own controls.
contract.accessibility: Name the collection with aria-label/aria-labelledby. Toggle buttons expose aria-pressed when Group value is supplied. This is a group of toggle buttons, not a radio group.

Button.nativeProps: Inherits Button native props, including aria-label and event handlers.

Input.element: Input inside a grouped div surface
Input.nativeProps: className goes to the grouped surface; other props follow Input forwarding. Native mode events reach the input, not the grouped wrapper.
Input.composition: Children mode renders a custom Input shell; provide your own editable control and event handlers there.

Select.nativeProps: Props follow Select. Accessibility labels/descriptions for the control belong on Select.Trigger.
Select.composition: Use Select.Trigger/Value and Select.Content/List/Item inside Group.Select. The panel anchors to this segment, not the entire Group.

examples.name: Basic toggle group
examples.description: Controlled toggles with accessible selected state and a named collection.
